title: Old master drawing exhibit at Vassar College
content: The Vassar College's Frances Lehman Loeb Art Museum in Poughkeepsie, New York is currently presenting "A Pioneering Collection: Master Drawings from the Crocker Art Museum."The exhibition shows fifty-seven rarely seen drawings dating from the late 15th  through the 19th centuries. Artists include Vittore  Carpaccio, Albrecht Dürer, Fra Bartolommeo, Federico Barocci, Peter Paul  Rubens, Anthony Van Dyck, François Boucher, Rembrandt van Rijn, Jean-Honoré Fragonard and  Jean-Auguste-Dominique Ingres.The collection comes from the Crocker Art  Museum in California. A scholarly catalog illustrates and explains the works.Vassar College's art museumis in Poughkeepsie, New York. The exhibit will be up through December 11.Exhibition checklist
